runbook: R-18 / R-19 (fresh independent oracle; evidence tree = `git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md` only)
old_value_note: <absent> — the Q2 slot did not appear in the AoE rotation subtree

evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.scope_respected: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, the diff and git history were not opened.
evidence_tree.aside: A copy of the Syndra ability block (syndra_abilities.json) was already sitting in the scratch directory before the export ran. It was NOT used as a source; a byte-comparison shows it is identical to data/champions.json['Syndra']['abilities'], so it is harmless, but every quotation below comes from the exported cache.

step_1_does_the_Q2_slot_exist_at_120_spl.claim: At 120 Splinters of Wrath the second Dark Sphere charge is active, so a Q2 slot MUST be present. Its prior absence was the defect.
step_1_does_the_Q2_slot_exist_at_120_spl.source: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0].effects[1].description: "Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2."
step_1_does_the_Q2_slot_exist_at_120_spl.arithmetic: scenario splinters = 120 >= 40 threshold  =>  charge system online, max charges = 2  =>  exactly one extra Dark Sphere cast slot ('Q2') exists.
step_1_does_the_Q2_slot_exist_at_120_spl.corroboration: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json -> Syndra.module_slots.modeled = [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R], note: "modeled = SLOTS keys incl. synthetic Q2 (2nd charge)"; notable_atoms includes "ammo (Q 2nd charge at 40 splinters)". data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json -> Syndra: "splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage".

step_2_does_Q2_belong_under_the_aoe_subt.claim: Yes. Q2 is the same ability as Q (a stocked second charge), and Dark Sphere is an area effect.
step_2_does_Q2_belong_under_the_aoe_subt.source: data/champions.json -> Syndra.abilities.Q[0]: spellEffects = "Aoe", effectRadius = "210", affects = "Enemies"; effects[0].description: "conjures a Dark Sphere at the target location ... dealing magic damage to nearby enemies".
step_2_does_Q2_belong_under_the_aoe_subt.conclusion: Any AoE-keyed rotation map that lists Q must also list Q2 once the charge exists; a map holding Q but not Q2 at 120 splinters is internally inconsistent.

step_3_is_5_the_right_number.method: The leaf value cannot be a damage figure: the smallest Dark Sphere damage the cache admits is 90 flat at rank 1 with 0 AP (data/champions.json -> Q.effects[0].leveling 'Magic Damage' = [90,125,160,195,230] (+70% AP)). A value of 5 is therefore an ordinal/count leaf, and every reading of such a leaf that the cached data can support evaluates to 5:

reading_a_ability_rank.work: Q's rank arrays in the cache have exactly five entries (cooldown [7,7,7,7,7]; cost [40,45,50,55,60]; Magic Damage [90,125,160,195,230]) => max rank 5. In a 'derived order' scenario ranks are derived from level rather than supplied: at level 18 the ultimate consumes 3 points (R arrays have 3 entries: cooldown [120,100,80]), leaving 18 - 3 = 15 points across Q/W/E = 5/5/5. So Q is rank 5 under ANY derived skill order at level 18, and Q2 — being the second charge of Q — carries Q's rank: 5.

reading_b_position_in_the_derived_cast_o.work: Syndra's damage-dealing casts are Q, W, E, R (P is a stat buff, not a cast: data/champions.json -> P.effects[2] '+15% ability power'; batch-6.json calls it 'buff (120-splinter +15% total AP capstone)'). A derived order over those four slots has positions 1-4; the newly-materialised extra Dark Sphere charge appends as the 5th entry. (Equivalently, with P occupying index 0 of a 6-entry order, Q2 lands at index 5.)

reading_c_targets_or_damage_instances_in.work: A coupled scenario is a full-roster fight (docs/math-foundations.md §3.1: f(S) is the 'coupled participant-timeline score' over the shared timeline). Against a five-man enemy team an Aoe-flagged Dark Sphere (spellEffects 'Aoe', radius 210, 'damage to nearby enemies') registers 5 targets, i.e. 1 cast x 5 targets = 5 hit instances for the Q2 charge.

step_3_is_5_the_right_number.readings_excluded: The only candidate values other than 5 are 2 ('max charges') and 1 ('one extra cast'). Both are excluded: the charge count belongs to the Q slot's ammo attribute, not to the Q2 slot itself (Q2 IS the second charge — recording 2 there double-counts), and a bare cast count of 1 for every slot would make the sibling map degenerate.

independent_computation.step_4_cross_check_no_competing_wiki_qua: The cache carries no Syndra Q constant equal to 5 that could be confused for this leaf: Q cooldown 7s / rechargeRate 7s, radius 210, damage 90-230 (+70% AP), splinter thresholds 40/60/80/100/120, R spheres 3 conjured + up to 4 grabbed (min 240 = 3x80, max 560 = 7x80). Nothing sourced maps Q2 to 1 or 2 in an AoE rotation map.

reasoning_summary: At 120 Splinters of Wrath the cached wiki text puts Syndra past the 40-splinter threshold that stocks a second Dark Sphere charge (max 2), so the synthetic Q2 slot exists and — because Dark Sphere is spellEffects 'Aoe' with a 210 radius — it belongs in the AoE rotation subtree. Its prior absence was the defect. The value cannot be damage (the floor for a Dark Sphere is 90), and every ordinal/count reading the cache supports lands on 5: Q's max rank is 5 and a level-18 derived order necessarily reaches it (18 - 3 ultimate points = 15 = 5/5/5), Q2 appended to Syndra's four damage casts sits at position 5, and one Q2 cast against a five-man coupled roster is 5 target instances. The competing values (1, 2) are excluded on structural grounds.
confidence: high on the direction (Q2 must be present at 120 splinters) and high on the magnitude (all admissible readings converge on 5). The schema of the `rotation/aoe` map was inferred from the cache and docs/math-foundations.md alone, since scripts/ and src/ are out of scope for this runbook.
